annotations.title: Match a BOM against JLCPCB basic parts

description: Checks each BOM line against JLCPCB's basic and preferred-extended parts in stock. Those load without a feeder fee on Economic assembly; every other unique part costs one. Matches by LCSC number (Cxxxx), manufacturer part number, or for resistors, capacitors and inductors by value and chip size, and suggests a footprint change when the same value is basic in another size. Returns per line status, part and price, plus the feeder fees in total. Free, read-only.

bom.description: The BOM as CSV text (KiCad or JLCPCB export: reference/designator, value/comment, footprint, quantity, mpn, lcsc columns) or as a list of lines.
